_nguon: Stage 1 — Classical Five-Element & Period-9 Flying Star spatial harmony overlay for the 'Classical Method & Five Elements' view. Practical environment, lighting, everyday materials and daily rhythm only — no rituals or commercial charms.

tieu_de.battu: Five-Element Balancing from Your Four Pillars
tieu_de.tuvi: Five-Element Alignment on the Life – Career – Wealth Axis

nguyen_tac_uu_tien.battu: Read both classical balancing lenses side by side (seasonal/strength balance and month-branch structure): prioritize elements supported by both, applied through workspace setup, colors, materials and daily focus hours.
nguyen_tac_uu_tien.tuvi: Use the Five-Element nature of the major stars in your Life, Career and Wealth palaces as your natural anchor for workspace tone and deep-work hours.
nguyen_tac_uu_tien.phongthuy: Clear non-conflicting priority order: (1) Real-world safety, daylight and ventilation come first; (2) Bed-head, stove-mouth and desk facing follow Eight Mansions for the householder; (3) Room colors, materials and quiet-versus-active use balance the Period-9 Flying Star pair in that sector.

Kim.mau_sac: Crisp white, light cream, silver-grey, soft metallic accents
Kim.chat_lieu: Clean metal frames, light stone surfaces, mechanical clock or minimal metal tray
thoi_quen: Clear your desk completely before starting decisions that require firm precision
Anchor financial and operational choices in concise written checklists

Mộc.mau_sac: Soft sage green, pale jade, natural wood grain
Mộc.chat_lieu: Natural timber desk or shelves, paper books, healthy leafy indoor plants
thoi_quen: Reserve early morning hours for long-term planning, learning and creative drafting
Take a 15–20 minute walk near trees to reset mental tension

Thủy.mau_sac: Deep navy, slate blue, cool off-white
Thủy.chat_lieu: Clean glass surfaces, soft flowing curtains, fresh drinking water on the desk
thoi_quen: Keep quiet reflection blocks for deep research and careful listening before negotiations
Stay well hydrated and leave buffer room in your schedule instead of rigid overbooking

Hỏa.mau_sac: Warm terracotta, muted amber, tea rose, sunlit gold (used as balanced accents)
Hỏa.chat_lieu: Warm-toned desk lamp, natural woven textiles, morning-sunlit corner
thoi_quen: Schedule presentations, client meetings and launches during late-morning peak energy
Open curtains early each day to bring natural daylight into your workspace

Thổ.mau_sac: Warm beige, sand, muted ochre, soft clay
Thổ.chat_lieu: Matte ceramic vessels, natural stone, steady flat woven rug
thoi_quen: Keep steady meal, sleep and weekly review times to build grounded momentum
Finish foundational tasks one by one before opening new commitments

ghi_chu_hai_cach.cung_can: Both classical lenses (balance/climate and month structure) favor {ds}.
ghi_chu_hai_cach.khac_nhau: Balance/climate favors {c1}, while month structure favors {c2} — test each gently in your routine and keep what feels steadier.
ghi_chu_hai_cach.trung_hoa: Your chart's Five Elements are already fairly balanced — keep spaces bright and adjust lightly by season.

tiet_khi_kim.ten: Metal-draining method for heavy Earth stars (5 Yellow or 2 Black)
tiet_khi_kim.ngu_hanh_dieu_hoa: Metal (white, light grey, tidy metalware) gently drains heavy Earth
tiet_khi_kim.ung_dung: Keep this sector quiet, clean and uncluttered; favor white or light-grey tones and tidy metal fixtures; avoid bright red accents, hot lamps, active water features or major drilling.

kich_vuong_van_9.ten: Welcoming Period-9 timely star 9 Purple & future star 1 White
kich_vuong_van_9.ngu_hanh_dieu_hoa: Balanced Wood – Fire – Water support by Mountain/Facing role
kich_vuong_van_9.ung_dung: Keep pathways open, let in daylight and use this sector regularly; place gentle clean water only when Facing star is 9 and neither 2 nor 5 is present.

kich_van_xuong.ten: Supporting 4 Green Literary Star — study, writing & clarity
kich_van_xuong.ngu_hanh_dieu_hoa: Water nourishes Wood, Wood brightens Fire
kich_van_xuong.ung_dung: Well suited for a tidy desk, bookshelf or study corner; a small healthy plant works well, while stacked paper clutter should be cleared.

thong_quan_thuy.ngu_hanh_dieu_hoa: Water (calm blue, clean glass) bridges Metal to nourish Wood
thong_quan_thuy.ung_dung: Reduce sharp metal clutter and noise here; use calm blue or soft white tones to cool verbal friction, and double-check contracts and locks.

dieu_hoa_hoa_kim.ngu_hanh_dieu_hoa: Earth (warm beige, matte ceramics) bridges Fire into Metal
dieu_hoa_hoa_kim.ung_dung: Avoid harsh glare or heat sources next to metal fixtures; use warm earth tones and ceramics, and keep electrical outlets tidy and inspected.

giu_on_dinh.ung_dung: Maintain fresh ventilation, comfortable lighting and clear walkways so the room stays steady and restful.

bt_thuan_hk_tinh.tieu_de: Two-School Lens at the Main Entrance (Eight Mansions & Period-9 Flying Stars)
bt_thuan_hk_tinh.goc_bat_trach: Eight Mansions lens (personal trigram alignment): this entrance direction matches the householder's group, supporting long-term personal steadiness.
bt_thuan_hk_tinh.goc_huyen_khong_van_9: Period-9 Flying Star lens (timely sector qi, star pair {cap}): the entrance sector carries stars that prefer calm, clutter-free Metal-toned moderation.
bt_thuan_hk_tinh.cach_dung_hoa: Keep your entrance, bed-head and stove facing aligned with Eight Mansions, while styling the doorway in crisp light neutral tones without harsh heat lamps or heavy drilling.

hk_vuong_bt_lech.tieu_de: Two-School Lens at the Main Entrance (Eight Mansions & Period-9 Flying Stars)
hk_vuong_bt_lech.goc_bat_trach: Eight Mansions lens (personal trigram alignment): this entrance direction belongs to the opposite East/West group from the householder.
hk_vuong_bt_lech.goc_huyen_khong_van_9: Period-9 Flying Star lens (timely sector qi, star pair {cap}): the entrance welcomes timely or prosperous Period-9 qi favorable for activity and commerce.
hk_vuong_bt_lech.cach_dung_hoa: Keep the entrance bright and open to welcome Period-9 flow, while orienting your bed-head, stove-mouth and desk chair toward your personal Eight Mansions directions.
